The '''Maya Kovel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]].
